answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 301 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wander. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the jetty queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The mesa index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 125 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
